maya (billing): quick follow-up from postmortem: delta in token attribution from delayed commits. need owners for credits, backfill, detection rule, and customer comms.
arjun (finance): i'll own credits + invoice corrections. need an accurate list of affected customers + token deltas.
liam (eng-infra): i'll build detection and dashboard. rule will fire to #metering-alerts + create MET-4601. ETA EOD tomorrow.

```csv
customer_id,window,missing_tokens
cust_102,2026-03-23T01:10Z-01:40Z,760
```

jordan (eng-sre): root cause looks like DB commit lock + retry batching. i'll add idempotent commits and lock timeout. PR in 24h, rollout 48h.
sophia (customer-success): i'll draft two comms: brief credit notice + detailed explainer. will hold send until credits applied.
liam (eng-infra): signal idea: "commit_delay_ms > 60000 && estimated_missing_tokens > 200". will emit ticket MET-4601 on trigger.
arjun (finance): rounding policy? propose nearest 50 tokens for <$5k/mo, nearest 500 for >$5k/mo.
maya (billing): approved. i'll update runbook.
billing-bot: MET-4601 created: "metering_commit_delay -> undercount".
arjun (finance): when detection list is final, i'll prepare CSV for AR: customer_id,token_delta,usd_credit,invoice_id. target 3 business days to complete corrections after list.
maya (billing): action items recap: liam -> detection + MET-4601 (EOD tomorrow); jordan -> idempotent commits (PR 24h, rollout 48h); arjun -> credit memos + invoice corrections (3 business days after list); sophia -> comms draft (12h). next sync in 48h. :white_check_mark:
